n01.roman: Rockstar ne GTA 6 abhi tak sirf PS5 aur Xbox Series X|S ke liye announce kiya hai.

n02.roman: PC ki koi official date nahi, aur PC par koi pre-order bhi nahi.

n03.roman: Twist: pichhli baar bhi yahi hua tha! GTA V console par September 2013 mein aaya, aur PC par April 2015 mein: kareeb 19 mahine baad.

n04.roman: Red Dead Redemption 2? Console par October 2018, PC par November 2019: kareeb ek saal baad.

n05.roman: Toh PC waalon, purana pattern intezaar ka hai, par GTA 6 PC ki koi tareekh pakki nahi. Jab tak Rockstar khud na bole, rumours par bharosa mat karna!
